records.cueHe: בעא מיניה רב דימי בר יוסף מרב נחמן
records.about: whether one who told his agent to go slaughter and then found the bird slaughtered may presume it was slaughtered properly
the bird has the presumptive status of having been slaughtered properly

records.cueHe: האומר לשלוחו ״צא ותרום״, והלך ומצא תרום, מאי
records.about: whether one who told his agent to separate teruma and then found produce from which teruma had been separated may presume the agent did it
the produce does not have the presumptive status of having had teruma separated from it
whether there is a presumption that an agent performs his agency — either it holds for teruma too, or it fails for slaughter too

records.cueHe: אמר ליה: לכי תיכול עלה כורא דמלחא, לעולם אין חזקה שליח עושה שליחותו
records.about: there is no presumption that an agent performs his agency; slaughter is permitted because whoever slaughtered was probably an expert, whereas teruma separated by another without the owner's knowledge is invalid
